cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(AcmeDiagnostics LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(FAULT_SOURCE ../../native/acme_faults.cpp)
option(ACME_CONTROLS_ONLY "Compile only non-GUI caught/corrected controls" OFF)
if(ACME_CONTROLS_ONLY)
  message(STATUS "Only bounded desktop controls selected")
elseif(WIN32)
  add_executable(AcmeDiagnostics WIN32 windows.cpp ${FAULT_SOURCE})
  target_link_libraries(AcmeDiagnostics PRIVATE user32 gdi32 Threads::Threads)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
  pkg_check_modules(GTK3 REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET gtk+-3.0)
  add_executable(AcmeDiagnostics linux.cpp ${FAULT_SOURCE})
  target_link_libraries(AcmeDiagnostics PRIVATE PkgConfig::GTK3 Threads::Threads)
else()
  message(STATUS "Native macOS AppKit app builds as described in tests/fixtures/diagnostics/apps/README.md")
endif()
add_executable(acme-controls controls.test.cpp ${FAULT_SOURCE})
target_link_libraries(acme-controls PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME bounded-desktop-controls COMMAND acme-controls)
# Assertions are the test contract even in optimized configurations.
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(acme-controls PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
else()
  target_compile_options(acme-controls PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
endif()
